newsitem.title: USA: AMETEK Inc completes consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: AMETEK Inc completes consent solicitation.

text.p: Ametek Inc said on Monday it had received the consents from the holders of a majority of its $150 million, 9.75 percent senior notes due 2004 to complete a consent solicitation and amend the terms of its notes indenture.
The solicitation, which expired on May 30, was proposed in connection with the sale of Ametek's water filtration business to Culligan Water Technologies Inc.
Ametek sought the consent to clarify that the proposed merger would not conflict with the terms of its notes indenture, Ametek said in a statement.

Following the spin off, Ametek's water filtration business will merge with Culligan in return for roughly 3.5 million shares of Culligan common stock. The new Ametek stock and Culligan stock issued in the transaction are intended to be distributed tax free to Ametek's shareholders, the company said.
Ametek is a global manufacturer of electrical and electromechanical products.
